department: Doctoral Programme in Molecular and Cellular Systems of Life (MaCS)

deadline.value: The rounds on the page are for the 2026-2027 academic year, and the page does not give a Fall 2027 start.

also.quote: Granted study rights will start on 1 March 2027

gre_subject.value: The MaCS pages do not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Applicants must have a supervisor when they submit the application, and the supervision statement must be signed by supervisors and the coordinating academic.
supervisor.quote: The doctoral programme requires that each applicant must have a supervisor or supervisors when submitting the application

also.quote: You must attach to your application this supporting statement form (pdf) signed or digitally signed by your supervisors and coordinating academic

funding.value: Funding for the first year must be secured and confirmed by the main supervisor at the application stage.
funding.quote: Funding for the first year, starting from the beginning of the study right, must be secured

entry_route.value: Applicants must have completed a second-cycle university degree, or an equivalent foreign qualification.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the Doctoral Programme in Molecular and Cellular Systems of Life (MaCS) must have completed: | An applicable second-cycle university degree

notes: Neurobiology is one of the five listed fields of science, so neuro is listed here as well as under biomed. The programme admits four times a year. Target degrees include the Faculty of Biological and Environmental Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Veterinary Medicine, Science and Agriculture and Forestry.
